title: Open Lab Animals Canada: open data on animal-based science in Canada (CCAC 2011-2025), international transparency comparison, and primate-research reporting audit
description: Machine-readable CCAC Animal Data Reports 2011-2025 with a species crosswalk and data-quality log; nonhuman-primate comparison with Great Britain, the EU and the US; a 12-dimension Transparency Index; a University Openness Scorecard; CIHR/NSERC funding by research approach; and an ARRIVE 2.0 reporting audit of Canadian primate neuroscience papers. Fully reproducible from public sources.
